milestones.title: M1: Native Wii U platform
milestones.summary: Reviewed TXT, saves, assets, pictures, silence/native tone and Minus exit evidence exists. Platform recovery, complete lifecycle/stability and installed-original-WUP acceptance remain open.
verified_foundations: Versioned native/guest RPX/WUHB builds and read-back-checked test-report/save publication lifecycle
Older native/control reports, confirmed Minus exit and user-reported Native/Guarded/Compiled v0.14.5 completion retained as scoped evidence

October 12 physical round: five completed named TXT reports, valid visit-2 snapshot, fresh-launch Save 0.14.6 RELOAD PASS and user-confirmed correct pictures/Minus return; looping launch music recorded separately
October 13 Audio Check 0.20.0 full trace and GX Transfers 0.20.0 result/trace record named passes; user confirms silence and correct exit. Native audio result TXT was not included.
acceptance_remaining: Verify documented SD publication recovery and repeat launch/Home/APT lifecycle acceptance
Complete documented native controls/audio/lifecycle/stability evidence
Install an original diagnostic WUP and prove Menu launch/exit

work_items.title: Verify current TXT result collection on Wii U
work_items.summary: Current named TXT collection is physically verified across Save, RomFS, SD assets and GX; preserve older missing-report failures separately. Project review can mark this scoped task Done without accepting M1.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh launch creates a uniquely named, closed-file read-back-verified TXT report in the documented SD results directory; its header identifies the tested build and diagnostic.
Upload the requested TXT files and preserved snapshot/siblings through the private intake route; retain automatic observations, user confirmations, failures and skips separately.
verified_foundations: Five completed named read-back reports and the full fresh-launch Save trace were privately reviewed; no failure or skip in their guides.

work_items.title: Verify repeat launch, exit and SD publication recovery
work_items.summary: Exercise the native application lifecycle and result/save persistence without discarding the earlier Minus-exit confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: A documented repeat-launch and Minus/Home/APT exit sequence returns to the Wii U Menu without a hang; record exact firmware, Aroma, launch route and build.

Save/relaunch retains the expected bytes, and any observed publication/recovery failure preserves readable previous data or reports an actionable error; record SD files while retaining the original failure evidence.

work_items.title: Record native display, controls and audio acceptance
work_items.summary: Retain older native/control evidence and fill only the missing checks needed for current platform acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: The native guide records TV/GamePad mapping, buttons, sticks, touch and the original native tone with observed results and build identity.
Any changed display, input, audio or lifecycle path has a focused console regression result; earlier successful checks are cited instead of repeating a long guide solely for a version bump.

work_items.title: Verify an original diagnostic as an installed Wii U title
work_items.summary: Use the validated original-homebrew WUP smoke package to prove installation and Wii U Menu launch rather than inferring them from RPX/WUHB launch.
acceptance_criteria: The original diagnostic installs with the recorded homebrew/installer environment and launches from the Wii U Menu with its expected title identity and screens.
The installed diagnostic exits normally and can be relaunched; retain the versioned build/package report and installation observations without exposing local packaging material.

work_items.title: Review and accept the native Wii U platform gate
work_items.summary: Collect the scoped native platform results into one reproducible acceptance record.
acceptance_criteria: The current result, lifecycle, controls/audio and installed-diagnostic tasks have reviewable evidence and no unexplained hang or persistence failure.
A versioned platform report states the tested firmware/Aroma/installer, supported launch routes and stability session; M1 remains open until this evidence is reviewed.

milestones.title: M2: CPU translation and performance
milestones.summary: Checked ARM/Thumb/VFP, portable generated ABI and observable fallback foundations exist. Broader exercised correctness, real Espresso costs and useful performance remain open.
verified_foundations: Original interpreter/AOT/reference suites and checked little-endian memory across host and emulated big-endian PowerPC
Eight single-core CPU/TLS/VFP contexts, scoped instruction/fault/synchronization semantics and external generated-code integration
acceptance_remaining: Complete exercised instruction/exception/exclusive/VFP and generated-code ABI correctness
Implement observable supported fallback and validated private missing-block trace handling
Measure real Wii U CPU/memory/fallback costs and assess useful performance

work_items.title: Complete exercised ARM, Thumb and VFP correctness
work_items.summary: Close concrete CPU gaps with independent references and original fixtures, preserving visible errors for unsupported behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Every supported new instruction/exception/exclusive/VFP case has independently checked register, flags, memory and fault results through the relevant interpreter/AOT paths.
Supported scope, remaining gaps and reference-model limits are documented; no unsupported instruction is accepted by a fabricated success result.

work_items.title: Complete the generated-code ABI and checked memory boundary
work_items.summary: Measure and tighten generated C integration, little-endian guest access, resume state and code/data ownership on the PowerPC target.
acceptance_criteria: Original generated-code fixtures match interpreter/reference state across calls, SVC/resume, threading and partial-fault boundaries on host and emulated big-endian PowerPC.
Release-build code size, memory/RSS, build cost and checked-access cost are recorded; optimizations preserve bounds, permissions and executable-store invalidation.

work_items.title: Implement observable fallback and missing-block trace handling
work_items.summary: Provide a correct, bounded recovery route for supported AOT misses and an actionable stop for unavailable execution states.
acceptance_criteria: An original missed-block/dynamic-dispatch fixture either executes through a verified supported fallback with state parity or fails explicitly before corrupting state.
Reports separate AOT instructions, fallback time/counts and unsupported locations; trace import validates input identity and stays private for user-derived code.

work_items.title: Measure real Espresso execution and memory costs
work_items.summary: Run representative original CPU/AOT workloads on physical Wii U before promising useful game performance.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned console benchmark records actual CPU/AOT/fallback, checked-memory and scheduling costs, build flags, memory peak and workload identity.
The report distinguishes emulated PowerPC correctness from actual Espresso timing and identifies measured bottlenecks for targeted optimization.

work_items.title: Review CPU correctness, fallback and performance acceptance
work_items.summary: Close the CPU milestone only against the exercised execution requirements and physical timing evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Instruction/ABI/fallback evidence establishes the documented supported workload without unexplained state mismatches or silent unsupported execution.
Actual Wii U timing and memory reports support a stated feasibility limit; useful selected-title gameplay performance is subsequently confirmed by the title gate.

milestones.title: M3: Homebrew execution runtime
milestones.summary: Nine original CRT/libctru apps cover startup, threads, input, display, saves, assets, transfers and bounded draws. Broader services/modules/guest audio and stable physical runtime acceptance remain open.
verified_foundations: Owned memory, eight single-core contexts and scoped kernel/IPC/SRV/CFG/HID/GSP/APT/FS contracts
Original compiled input/framebuffer/save/reload/RomFS/GX applications verified on desktop, sanitizers and selected emulated PowerPC comparisons

Physical Save 0.14.6 fresh-process reload, embedded RomFS 0.14.6, SD-file RomFS 0.16.0 and GX 0.18.0 transfer/configuration guides completed with zero fallback/fault; user confirmed pictures and Minus return.

Original normal-CRT PICA draw guest has host exact-pixel checks and an October 13 physical own PASS/exit with zero fallback/fault; rendered second presentation at 57.33 seconds. User separately confirms pictures and Minus return.
acceptance_remaining: Prove current compiled guest display/input/exit/save/assets on Wii U
Extend exercised service/app lifecycle, module and guest DSP/audio contracts
Record stable physical guest-runtime acceptance without inferring commercial compatibility

work_items.title: Verify the normal-CRT homebrew suite on Wii U
work_items.summary: Retain reviewed physical Save, RomFS/Asset Files, GX and bounded draw results. The new draw startup delay and guide timing require focused investigation; unchanged completed routes need no blanket repeat.
acceptance_criteria: Current compiled guests update both screens, respond to the required input/touch, complete their documented exit and retain their versioned observations.
Save fresh-process reload, nested/Unicode read-only assets and GX transfer pictures/results match the documented original fixtures; unresolved errors are investigated instead of marked passed.

work_items.title: Extend exercised kernel, IPC and application contracts
work_items.summary: Advance the shared scheduler/memory/SRV/APT/CFG/HID/GSP/FS contracts using original applications and later observed title requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Each added service or kernel behavior has checked request shapes, ownership, scheduling/teardown and failure cases backed by an original fixture.
Unsupported applets, cross-process semantics and privileged/optional services stay explicit; generic success is used only where its observable behavior is justified.

work_items.title: Implement checked dynamic-module loading and dispatch
work_items.summary: Add the portable CRO/CRS loading, relocation and translated-module boundary required for executable integration.
acceptance_criteria: An original module fixture loads, relocates, calls and unloads through interpreter/AOT with checked ranges, symbols and code ownership; malformed relocation inputs fail visibly.

Supported module forms and dispatch/ownership limits are documented; unsupported forms fail visibly, while actual title module requirements are subsequently established in the private revision matrix.

work_items.title: Build the guest DSP/audio path with original probes
work_items.summary: Separate native diagnostic tone evidence from the unimplemented guest audio protocol and Wii U output pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Original guest audio fixtures exercise the implemented DSP/service path with checked buffers/voices and independently verified sample/timing results.
Wii U output, synchronization, pause/exit and resource cleanup have focused console observations; unsupported audio commands fail visibly.

work_items.title: Accept a stable compiled guest runtime on Wii U
work_items.summary: Prove the milestone fixture really executes guest code with the documented kernel/services, display and input on physical hardware.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned normal-CRT guest demonstrates guest execution, two-screen updates, input/touch, filesystem/assets as exercised and clean exit or a recorded stability session on Wii U.
Its CPU/service/fallback requirements and known limits are documented; passing the fixture does not claim retail services, PICA draws or Mario compatibility.

milestones.title: M4: PICA to GX2 rendering
milestones.summary: Compiled guest GSP/MOV draws produce exact CPU software scenes through owned tiled targets. Broader shader/TEV/sampling, native GX2 translation/coherency and physical Wii U acceptance remain open.
verified_foundations: Direct/shared framebuffer presentation and all 14 base texture formats with original/reference checks
Bounded GSP DMA/fill/display-transfer/raw-texture-copy/cache queue operations and completion interrupts
v0.18 finalized no-draw viewport/scissor PICA command lists, checked wire inspection and transactional guest-queue integration
Original bounded vertex attribute decoding: four published component formats, explicit streams/input permutation and transactional finite-float/range/alias validation; no shader or draw enabled
v0.21.0 adds unsigned 8-bit/16-bit indexed gathers, exhaustive index-domain checks and full referenced-range/value/alias validation before publication; no shader or draw enabled

v0.22.0 original owned-resource loader/MOV shader/software triangles: 1,393,972 original assertions, exact analytic pixels for both index formats and 12,290 pinned independent encoding checks; focused native Scene Check cross-build, hardware evidence pending
Standard guest GSP integrates bounded owned-resource PICA draws transactionally; the compiled original draws four exact triangles into both targets and displays them with zero fallback.

October 13 Guest Draws 0.23.0 has matching two-step PASS result/trace, four triangles, 97,200 fragments and user-confirmed pictures/exit. Aggregate frame timing and premature visual-prompt timing are recorded; full graphics costs remain unmeasured.
acceptance_remaining: Implement real PICA command/state, vertex/shader, texture/sampler/TEV and raster behavior
Complete GPU resources, readback/coherency and explicit shader/cache miss handling
Compare original reference scenes and measured physical Wii U rendering costs

work_items.title: Decode PICA state and submit bounded draw commands
work_items.summary: The standard guest GSP queue now resolves owned physical resources, retains PICA shader/state and atomically commits bounded original software draws and completion. Both command-task criteria are reviewed; broader renderer and physical M4 acceptance remain open.
acceptance_criteria: Original command streams establish register/state changes, draw inputs and validated resource ranges; malformed or unsupported state fails visibly before modifying output.
The decoder feeds a documented renderer boundary, with reference traces that distinguish CPU-written framebuffer presentation from actual PICA draws.
verified_foundations: Configuration and bounded compiled guest draw lists retain shader/state, commit tiled targets atomically and signal synchronous P3D only after success.
evidence: Reviewed v0.23 command acceptance: PR #48 configuration plus PR #57 compiled guest draws, exact target/display reference traces and 83,108 normal/sanitizer assertions meet both bounded command-task criteria; the Actions review records task #27 Done without accepting M4.

work_items.title: Implement vertex formats, shader execution and GX2 translation
work_items.summary: First bounded MOV shader and original software scenes pass exact independent pixel/encoding checks. Broader shader coverage, a license-cleared GX2 shader route and measured physical console costs remain open.
acceptance_criteria: Original vertex/shader scenes compare independently checked outputs across the reference and chosen GX2/software correctness path using stated tolerances.
Shader tooling licenses, generated-code ownership, supported instructions and miss behavior are documented; a software correctness path has measured costs rather than an assumed final speed.
evidence: v0.19.0 adds the original bounded runtime/core/ctr_vertex byte-stream decoder and exhaustive original tests; resolving PICA loaders, fixed/index attributes, shader execution and actual draws remain required.
v0.21.0 implements original checked unsigned 8-bit/16-bit indexed array gathering with 364,123 original assertions; PICA loader/fixed state, uniforms, shaders and actual draws remain open.

v0.22.0 implements original exact-value MOV/NOP/END shaders, loader/fixed/uniform state, output maps and opaque triangles; focused Scene Check builds and exposes automatic pixels/timings plus separate human confirmation. No general shader, guest GSP draw or full task acceptance.

work_items.title: Implement textures, samplers, TEV and raster state
work_items.summary: Connect the verified base texture decoders to real draws and the fragment behavior required by reference scenes and the selected title.
acceptance_criteria: Original scenes cover exercised texture layouts/samplers, TEV stages, blend, depth, stencil and alpha tests with reference images and stated comparison tolerances.
Required lighting/LUT/geometry/procedural behavior is added from observed requirements or remains explicitly unsupported; texture-decoder tests alone do not claim renderer acceptance.

work_items.title: Implement GPU resource coherency and versioned shader/state caches
work_items.summary: Handle render-to-texture, aliases, completion/readback and CPU/GPU ownership while making shader/cache misses explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Original resource scenes prove guest-visible writes/readbacks, alias invalidation and synchronization ordering without stale data or unchecked GPU access.
Cache identity includes relevant code/runtime/renderer/settings inputs; missing or invalid state follows a supported translation/fallback or diagnostic failure, never silent incorrect rendering.

work_items.title: Compare rendered scenes and measure Wii U graphics costs
work_items.summary: Retain the reviewed original compiled draw pictures and own PASS/exit; correct premature visual gating and separately measure CPU/GPU/transfer/wait/memory costs before full graphics or title acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Physical Wii U images match the defined scene tolerances and required visual checks; build/reference identity and unsupported features accompany the results.
CPU submission, GPU work, transfers, waits, memory and frame-time distribution are measured on Wii U; selected-title scenes are later validated through M5.

milestones.title: M5: Super Mario 3D Land revision
milestones.summary: Mario is selected; the newly supplied reportedly decrypted CCI exceeds the transfer limit. Exact owned revision/assets, title requirements and gameplay/audio/save/performance remain unverified.
verified_foundations: Candidate and proposed private analysis/gameplay route documented
Local preparation/decryption/intake helpers tested with original fixtures; actual commercial executable/assets not inspected
acceptance_remaining: Obtain and privately identify an owned executable/assets and exact revision
Implement the observed title CPU/services/modules/renderer/audio/retail-save requirements
Prove boot/menu/gameplay/input/audio/save/reload/stability and useful Wii U performance

work_items.title: Identify the owned Super Mario 3D Land executable and assets
work_items.summary: Obtain a locally prepared/decrypted private executable export and asset inventory for the user-selected first candidate.
acceptance_criteria: The actual NCCH/container metadata and input/executable hashes establish the exact title, region and revision; filename claims are not treated as verified identity.
Required RomFS/modules/assets are available through the documented private workflow; keys stay local and no commercial payload is placed in issues, source or public artifacts.

work_items.title: Create the exact-revision feature and test-route matrix
work_items.summary: Analyze declared capabilities and observed execution separately to prioritize the selected title requirements.
acceptance_criteria: A private analysis records code/module layout, actual unsupported CPU/IPC/GPU/audio/save behavior and the distinction between declared services and observed use.
A hash-matched profile and short repeatable boot/menu/course/save route are documented with explicit support gaps; upstream desktop claims do not activate the profile.

work_items.title: Implement the selected revision requirements
work_items.summary: Connect the private title to the shared CPU/runtime/renderer and implement only its evidenced missing behaviors.
acceptance_criteria: Observed requirements drive CPU/services/applets/CFG-Mii identity, modules, RomFS, guest audio, retail saves/extdata and PICA integration with targeted original regression fixtures.

The exact-revision build progresses through recorded boot/menu/gameplay stages without unjustified stub success; prefer reusable shared fixes, and keep any necessary title-specific adjustment narrow, hash-matched and documented.

work_items.title: Run Mario boot, gameplay, audio and save/reload on Wii U
work_items.summary: Execute the agreed short route on a manually staged per-game build before automating the finished injection.
acceptance_criteria: Physical evidence covers cold boot, menu, interactive course movement/jump and required touch, synchronized audio, save, exit and fresh-launch reload.
Record exact revision/build/environment, graphics/audio faults, frame-time distribution, memory peak and fallback time while preserving intended guest speed.

work_items.title: Review supported-title accuracy, stability and performance
work_items.summary: Enable a verified commercial profile only after review of the exact-revision console route and its measured limits.
acceptance_criteria: The recorded gameplay/save route and agreed stability session pass with documented graphical/audio limitations, intended timing and useful measured performance.
The profile identifies exactly the tested hashes/settings/environment and unresolved limitations; unavailable revisions and arbitrary-ROM compatibility remain unsupported.

milestones.title: M6: Automated ROM to WUP conversion
milestones.summary: Original intake/decryption, AOT builds and synthetic package verification exist. Full clean-Windows commercial conversion, installer/Menu launch and rebuild/save acceptance remain open.
verified_foundations: Local key/seed import, bounded decryption/intake/RomFS preparation and original encrypted-input to external AOT/RPX/WUHB proof
Original synthetic encrypted packing plus independent decrypt/FST/hash/file verification and atomic output
Passed hosted native Windows host/portable-C, real external AOT/Unicode execution and .NET 10 WPF tooling checks
acceptance_remaining: Establish actual local packaging provenance and original diagnostic installer acceptance
Complete selected-game stage orchestration, cancellation/caches/traces/rebuild and safe stable title identities
Verify clean native Windows commercial conversion and WUP Menu launch/save continuity/uninstall

work_items.title: Validate original-homebrew WUP packaging and installer prerequisites
work_items.summary: Take the original scoped writer/verifier beyond synthetic structure checks using documented local material and a smoke-test diagnostic.
acceptance_criteria: The original diagnostic WUP has consistent collision-checked nonreserved identity, original metadata/artwork, verified content integrity and documented local packaging provenance/installer requirements.

The supported installer accepts the actual package on Wii U; retain the package/build report and observations privately where needed, distinguishing integrity from signature policy and install success.

work_items.title: Connect the real selected-game ROM-to-WUP stages
work_items.summary: Complete the shared engine sequence from supported input through AOT/runtime/assets/shaders/staging/packing/validation to published output.
acceptance_criteria: The exact supported revision completes inspect/profile/extract/translate/compile/cache/link/stage/metadata/pack/validate with machine-readable reports and nonzero errors for failed stages.
Output is published atomically only after identity/content checks; an unsupported game or experimental gap cannot be reported as a finished playable WUP.

work_items.title: Finish cancellation, trace import and revision-aware rebuilds
work_items.summary: Make interrupted/repeated conversion reliable while keeping per-game identities and saves stable.
acceptance_criteria: Original and selected-title cases verify stage cancellation, disk-space failures, interruption cleanup and cache invalidation keyed by all relevant inputs/settings/tool/runtime versions.
Rebuild and validated private trace import preserve title/save identity, reject unsafe overrides/collisions, and avoid presenting incomplete output as a successful package.

work_items.title: Run full native conversion on clean Windows
work_items.summary: Extend the passed hosted Windows baseline/deep AOT/WPF tooling proof to the actual supported-game engine and its devkitPPC prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria: A clean Windows machine follows documented setup and completes the selected-title conversion, including actual native toolchain execution, spaced/Unicode paths and actionable missing-dependency errors.

Cancellation/retry/rebuild and report/output behavior pass without manual source edits or undocumented shells; existing CI tooling checks remain supporting evidence rather than full conversion acceptance.

work_items.title: Verify installed commercial WUP, rebuild/save continuity and uninstall
work_items.summary: Establish the real engine output as a stable per-game Wii U Menu title after Windows conversion.
acceptance_criteria: The generated WUP installs and Menu-launches into the agreed supported gameplay/audio/save route in the recorded console/installer environment.
Rebuilding/updating the same title preserves saves, independent titles do not share saves accidentally, and documented user-directed uninstall behavior is verified.

milestones.title: M7: Windows GUI injector
milestones.summary: The WPF injector workflow and supported development tooling are specified. Implement the GUI over the proven engine, private setup/rebuild/diagnostics and clean-Windows playable-WUP acceptance.
verified_foundations: User-reviewed Select ROM/configure/Inject/WUP workflow and encrypted-input amendment documented
Hosted .NET 10 WPF toolchain validation is development evidence; no finished GUI exists
acceptance_remaining: Implement the responsive GUI over the proven shared engine with actual prerequisites
Provide private key setup, saved-project/rebuild and redacted exportable diagnostics
Accept packaged clean-Windows Inject-to-WUP plus physical installed gameplay/save/stability

work_items.title: Finalize the GUI engine request, progress and report contract
work_items.summary: After a proven conversion pipeline, expose its versioned readiness/build/cancel/rebuild results to the Windows front end.
acceptance_criteria: The GUI contract uses the same proven engine, reports real stage/progress/errors and preserves profile/compatibility and package-validation versus console-evidence distinctions.
Original integration fixtures demonstrate readiness, cancellation and retry without hiding failed stages; GUI implementation starts only after the execution/conversion gate is met.

work_items.title: Implement the UWUVCI-style 3DS Inject workflow
work_items.summary: Build the C# WPF Windows app around the proven engine and the reviewed user workflow.
acceptance_criteria: CTR2WUP.exe provides ROM detection/status, title and icon/TV/GamePad artwork configuration, implemented display settings, WUP output choice and one primary Inject action.
The app remains responsive during real conversion, supports Cancel/Retry and offers completion/report/Open output guidance without routine manual compiler commands.

work_items.title: Provide dependency setup and private local key import help
work_items.summary: Make decrypted input and optional user-owned encrypted-input preparation usable without bundling keys or undocumented prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria: First-run setup documents/provisions actual supported tools; local export/import/remove help identifies needed keys/seeds and gives actionable missing/wrong-material failures.

Windows protected storage, redacted diagnostics, cancellation cleanup and exported-project/package exclusions are verified with original fixtures and a locally owned encrypted input; console extraction help never claims stock USB key access.

work_items.title: Implement saved projects, rebuild and exportable diagnostics
work_items.summary: Expose stable per-game rebuilds and helpful reports through the GUI while keeping technical detail in expandable controls.
acceptance_criteria: Saved-project reopen/import/export and runtime-update rebuild preserve validated title/settings identity and save continuity; imported private traces follow engine validation.
GUI reports identify build/profile/status, actual stage failures and output location while excluding keys and commercial payloads; advanced unavailable settings cannot appear effective.

work_items.title: Package and accept clean-Windows Inject-to-playable-WUP
work_items.summary: Deliver the complete first MVP through the Windows GUI and the agreed physical-console route.
acceptance_criteria: A clean Windows machine runs the packaged app with documented/provisioned prerequisites, selects the exact supported revision, configures it and obtains its validated WUP via Inject, including cancel/retry/rebuild checks.
That WUP installs, launches from the Wii U Menu and passes gameplay/input/audio/save/reload/stability plus rebuild/save continuity; release notes identify exact support and limitations.

state_fields_usage: Initial seeding and dated evidence snapshots only; never overwrite existing Project status or waiting resources.

console_result_collection_review.scope: Named TXT collection and private original snapshot intake; no full milestone acceptance
